rows.description: A red brick church with a tall tower stands in the center, surrounded by a blue and green patterned field. The church is lit from behind, so its walls glow red and the windows are dark blue.

rows.description: A still life of two sunflowers in a green vase on a dark table, with a blue bird on the right and a green cloth draped over the left side. The background is a warm yellow-green.

A village street with houses in ochre, green and blue, a red roof and a white gate on the right. A woman in a red dress walks along the path in the middle, and a dog runs towards her. The paint is applied thickly.

A dense, colorful landscape with tall dark purple and red trees on the right and a bright orange and yellow sky behind them. A few small figures in white and blue walk along a path in the lower center.

A dark, almost black painting of a harbor with three large boats in the foreground, each rowed by a man. Small figures stand on the boats and on the quay. The background is a dark silhouette of houses and a city skyline. The paint is applied thickly.

A greyish beige canvas with large blue, orange and black letters '17' in the center, surrounded by small red and green leaf-like shapes. A black dot appears above the '1', and a black line runs across the top edge.
A blue field with long thin white and green lines curving across it like fish or birds in flight. Small red and pink dots appear among the lines.
c: Light Blue Sky with Fish Shapes

rows.description: A face-like shape with a round yellow head and a small red nose set against a dark brown background. The face has two black dots for eyes and a small curved line for a mouth. The color palette is warm orange, red and yellow on a cool brown ground.

A spring landscape with two tall willow trees on the left, a woman in a red dress sitting on the grass in the foreground, and a village in the distance. The ground is covered with yellow flowers and the sky is soft golden. The paint is applied in loose, dappled strokes.
A portrait of a bearded man in a white chef's hat and apron, with a black neckerchief. His face is painted with quick, loose strokes in pale green, yellow and white.

rows.description: A harbor scene with tall masts of sailing ships in the middle ground, reflected in calm water. The sky is blue with white clouds and a faint glow of light. Small figures stand on the right.

A lively café scene with three men in black hats and suits sitting on a balcony, drinking orange juice from tall glasses. A woman in a yellow dress sits next to them, and a man in a white hat stands behind her. The background shows a city street with buildings and a red-brick wall.
a: Men in Black Hats, Orange Juice

rows.description: A woman in a long white dress with a red flower on her waistband walks leftward, her head turned back and hair flying. Her right arm is raised, holding a small black bird. The background is a simple grey field.
a: Woman in Long White Dress with Black Bird
Lively Scene with Woman and Bird
Woman in White Dress with Red Flower
c: Woman in White with Red Flower

rows.real: Still life with fruits and watermelon
rows.description: A still life of sliced watermelons, grapes and a mango on a red tablecloth, with a blue napkin and a white cloth in the background. The fruit is painted in thick, flat colors.

A sunny park scene with a wide path winding through trees on the left, leading to a grassy area with a few figures in the distance. A blue bench sits under a tree on the right. The sky is blue with white clouds.

rows.real: Still Life. Lilacs in a tub.
rows.description: A still life of a wooden basket filled with pink lilacs on a dark brown table. The flowers spill out of the basket, with green leaves and a few buds. The background is a dark brown field.

A night landscape with a dark blue sky and a glowing red-orange light in the upper right. A dark figure in a red dress walks along a path on the left, while a small green tree appears below. The colors are bold and flat.

A bright tropical scene with a tall palm tree in the center, its trunk painted in dark blue and red leaves in orange and red. Two small figures sit under the tree, and two elephants stand nearby. Yellow and blue buildings form a row behind them. The sky is a clear blue.

A watercolor-like cityscape with a red building on the right, a green tree in the left foreground and a blue sky above. Figures in dark blue and red stand on a red platform in the lower middle. The paint is loose and expressive.
A young girl with dark hair tied in a loose bun wears a white bonnet and a white dress with a lace collar. She looks down, her face half hidden by the bonnet. The background is a warm yellow.
a: Girl with Lace Collar and Bonnet

rows.description: A woman in a long white dress with a high collar and a hat stands with her hands on her hips. She holds a fan in her right hand. The background is dark with a blue band across the top and a patterned floor.

A woman in a white dress kneels before a large piano, her head bowed. She plays a single note on the keyboard while a figure in a dark cloak sits behind her. The scene is framed by a round window or mirror-like oval shape.
